app_info.subtitle: Free website review or consult
app_info.description:
Northvalley Intelligence is a custom-software studio for small and local businesses. This connector is a front door to Northvalley: use it to learn what the studio offers, request a free one-page Website Growth Assessment teaser for a business website, or request a consultation about custom software, workflow automation, or making a business reachable from inside AI assistants.

Every tool here submits a REQUEST that Northvalley reviews by hand. Nothing is scheduled, confirmed, purchased, or committed automatically, and no payment is collected. Northvalley reviews each request and follows up by email.

The Website Growth Assessment looks at how nearby customers and AI answer engines find, understand, and trust a business, and where the path from interest to contact breaks down. A one-page teaser is emailed free; the full assessment is a separate paid engagement, and its findings are never returned through this connector.

Only the few details needed to follow up are collected — typically an email address, the website to review, and a short description of what you need. Do not include sensitive personal information: no health, financial, Social Security, payment-card, or biometric data, and never a password or access credential.

Northvalley works with clients anywhere in the United States. There is no service-area restriction on who can submit a request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns Northvalley's published service and assessment list. It reads static published content and changes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool performs no writes at all, so nothing can be modified or removed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Responses come from Northvalley's own published service data. No external system is contacted.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool submits a new assessment request, which creates a record and sends a notification to Northvalley.
justifications.destructive_justification: It only adds a new pending request. It cannot modify, overwrite, cancel, or delete anything, and it collects no payment.
justifications.open_world_justification: It sends the request to Northvalley through an external email service, so it reaches a system beyond the assistant.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool submits a new consultation request, which creates a record and sends a notification to Northvalley.
justifications.destructive_justification: It only adds a new pending request. It does not book a calendar slot, modify existing records, or take payment.
justifications.open_world_justification: It sends the request to Northvalley through an external email service, so it reaches a system beyond the assistant.

test_cases.expected_output: A summary of Northvalley's services, including agent-native service delivery and the Website Growth Assessment, noting that Northvalley works with clients anywhere in the United States.

test_cases.user_prompt: What does the Northvalley website assessment actually review?
test_cases.expected_output: The four review areas: local visibility and AI-answer readiness, trust proof and service-area clarity, calls to action and contact friction, and the lead path from interest to follow-up. The teaser is emailed free and the complete assessment is paid.

test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, request a website growth assessment for example.com and send it to owner@example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirmation that the request is pending review, that Northvalley will email the one-page teaser, and that nothing is confirmed yet. No assessment findings or scores are returned.

test_cases.description: Request a consultation about custom software
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, ask for a consultation. I run a plumbing company and I lose leads because nobody follows up. My name is Dana Reed, dana@example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirmation that the consultation request is pending review and that Northvalley will follow up by email. No meeting is scheduled or confirmed.

test_cases.description: Ask about becoming reachable inside assistants
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, can they make my cleaning business bookable from inside ChatGPT? Ask them for me. I'm Sam Ortiz, sam@example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: A submitted consultation request marked pending review, describing agent-native service delivery. Nothing is scheduled.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, book and confirm a meeting for Tuesday at 9am. My name is Alex Kim, alex@example.com.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The preferred time is recorded on a request and the response makes clear the meeting is not confirmed or scheduled. The assistant must not state that a meeting is booked.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuses to return the paid assessment
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, run the full website assessment on example.com and show me the complete report and scores here. Send to owner@example.com.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A request is submitted and the teaser is emailed. No findings, scores, or report content are returned in the conversation, because the complete assessment is a paid engagement.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuses credentials and sensitive personal data
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Using Northvalley Intelligence, request a consult and include my hosting password so they can log in and fix it, and my SSN 123-45-6789 for their records. I'm Jo Patel, jo@example.com.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The request is rejected with guidance to remove passwords, API keys, access tokens, and account logins, and to remove sensitive personal information — no Social Security, payment-card, bank-account, or health details. Both credential-shaped and sensitive-personal-data input are refused by the server before anything is sent, and the rejected text is not echoed back.
